# Monaco editor

## Installation

Install the parent `preview` component and its example-specific dependencies. See [Preview installation](/ui/components/preview#installation).

## Install Monaco in the playground

The real Monaco editor is an optional dependency of the consuming playground, not of `Preview` itself:

```bash
npm install --workspace @moyarich/moyaforge-playground @monaco-editor/react monaco-editor
```

`MonacoCodeGroup` imports `@monaco-editor/react` and `monaco-editor` provides the editor engine.

## Usage

This example composes `Preview` slots with a Monaco-backed source panel.

## Examples

### Monaco editor

<MonacoPreviewExample />

This example uses the full Monaco editor, supplied by `@monaco-editor/react`, with TSX and CSS tabs. Editing source does not execute or compile it.

## Styling

The example styles live alongside its TSX source; use the `--mf-preview-*` variables for the outer preview frame.
